items.title: Alibaba’s (BABA) AI Growth Prospects Remain Masked by Short-Term Challenges
items.summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) offers promising artificial intelligence (AI) growth prospects, but its short-term struggles continue to weigh on the stock. The Chinese tech giant has failed to gain traction following its regulatory nightmare in 2020. In the past 12 months alone, Alibaba stock has lost around 37% of its value.
